# Marhaba DMC

> White-label travel portal for travel agents and entrepreneurs. Halal-friendly destinations, Hajj/Umrah modules, Flight/Hotel/Visa APIs, and AI sales tools. Launch your branded travel business in 24 hours.

Marhaba DMC equips travel agents and entrepreneurs with a fully branded booking portal, content inventory, training, and AI-powered sales assistants. Plans are available as monthly or annual subscriptions across Launch, Growth, and Authority tiers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, pricing, and how the white-label portal works.
- [About](/about): Company story, team, philosophy, and global presence.
- [Pricing](/#pricing): Launch, Growth, and Authority plans with monthly and annual billing.
- [Book a Demo](/book-demo): Schedule a live walkthrough with the team.
- [Sign Up](/signup): Subscribe to a plan and create a portal.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales and support contact details.
- [Categories & Destinations](/categories-destinations): Curated destinations and halal-friendly travel categories.
- [Umrah Visa Check](/umrah-visa-check): Free Saudi Umrah visa status checker.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on travel business, halal tourism, Hajj/Umrah, and industry insights.
